# netbox_owner (Resource)

Manages a NetBox owner (`/api/users/owners/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_owner" "example" {
  name = "example"
  group_id = netbox_owner_group.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Owner Group (`netbox_owner_group`).
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `user_group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned User Group (`netbox_user_group`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned User (`netbox_user`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_owner can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_owner.example 123
```
